name: @projexlight/cli
summary: The projex command-line tool — developer entry point to ProjexCloud. Subcommands: init / install / blueprint / registry / login / deploy / version / help. `projex init --hosted-url` writes SSE entries into Claude Code / Cursor / Windsurf / Cline mcp.json files so customers wire up the hosted MCP without manual config.

hooks.name: runInit
hooks.description: Create a new app dir + scaffold + write mcp.json files.

hooks.name: runInstall
hooks.description: Add an SDK to the current app's package.json + drop an integration stub.

hooks.name: runRegistryList
hooks.description: List SDKs in the local catalog with optional tag/search filter.

hooks.name: runBlueprintApply
hooks.description: Apply a blueprint — render outputs + optionally install SDKs.

scenarios.title: Customer wires up Claude Code to the hosted MCP in one command
scenarios.when_to_use: Most common first-touch flow: customer has a JWT, wants their AI tools talking to the hosted MCP without copy-pasting config.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Creates my-app/ with scaffolded code; writes SSE entry into every detected AI-tool mcp.json. Claude Code / Cursor / Windsurf / Cline all light up with projex_registry_* tools on next launch.

scenarios.title: Add an SDK to an existing app
scenarios.when_to_use: Mid-development — `projex install @projexlight/sdk-evidence` adds the dep + drops a starter integration file.
scenarios.expected_outcome: package.json updated; src/integrations/sdk-evidence.ts written. src/index.ts re-exports the integration.

scenarios.title: Apply a blueprint including SDK installs
scenarios.when_to_use: Fast path to a working vertical — clones the blueprint into the current app + auto-installs every required SDK.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Templates rendered with operator-answered clarifying questions; all 5 SDKs added to package.json; integration stubs written.

scenarios.title: Pull the latest catalog into the local cache
scenarios.when_to_use: After a new SDK ships — `projex registry refresh` pulls the fresh catalog so local searches reflect it.
scenarios.example_code:
$ projex registry refresh
Downloaded registry.catalog.json (73 SDKs)
Downloaded registry.embeddings.bin
scenarios.expected_outcome: ~/.projex/cache updated. registry-mcp-local picks up the new catalog on next stdio connection.

scenarios.title: Browse the catalog with a tag filter
scenarios.when_to_use: Discovery from the CLI without launching an AI tool.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Filtered list rendered. Pipes to grep / awk friendly.

compliance_posture.notes: Authentication via OAuth device-flow (deferred to login command, currently stub). API tokens stored in OS keychain when supported; fallback to env.
